substantiveCommits.purpose: Add a deterministic reflection lightmap-binding fingerprint covering the ordered baked lightmap array plus per-renderer baked/realtime lightmap index and atlas scale-offset state.
Extend the machine-readable render-state coherence contract with fail-closed GI-binding requirements while preserving the existing schema consumed by the canonical render-state validator.
Fold the lightmap-binding digest into the canonical reflection lighting fingerprint used at request/poll/completion/pre-still boundaries.
Add DynamicGI.indirectScale to the canonical lighting fingerprint so legal indirect-energy drift cannot survive reflection synchronization.
Require DynamicGI indirect-scale identity in the machine-readable reflection synchronization contract.
Make the lighting-coverage validator fail closed if DynamicGI indirect-scale coverage is removed from the reflection synchronization contract.

priorityDecision.reason: The existing render-state fingerprint covered renderer identity, transform, mesh, material, texture, shadow/probe/sorting state and rejected hidden MaterialPropertyBlocks, but did not explicitly freeze renderer lightmap atlas bindings. Unity also exposes DynamicGI.indirectScale as a render-changing control over realtime and baked lightmap contribution. Both channels can materially alter indirect illumination while other formal evidence remains individually valid, so they were higher-value to close than speculative asset expansion without a Runner.

expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.reason: Prevents reflection cubemaps and stills from being accepted when indirect-light energy or renderer-to-lightmap atlas bindings differ despite stable direct sun/material state.
Keeps metal/glass Fresnel and roughness review tied to one coherent indirect-illumination state instead of allowing GI drift to masquerade as material response.
Prevents indirect-energy drift from contaminating exposure/color judgments between synchronized reflection evidence and the final still.

nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 Editor/Runner execution. On first availability, stop speculative expansion; compile the new fingerprint, establish a clean request hash, inject a lightmapIndex or lightmapScaleOffset mutation during an in-flight probe and require fail-closed mismatch, separately change DynamicGI.indirectScale and require mismatch, restart clean, refresh probes, capture native 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing frames plus 100% crops, and only then score the Visual Fidelity Gate from actual pixels.
